Frames 9042-164815 and 9002-157019 draw no inline ticket at either tablet board and MobileTradeShell's bottom bar is the affordance report aa51a8be asked for, so the collapse was unreachable code rather than a scoped-down feature. DELTA ZERO re-derived on the row this frame settles: gutter 2.5+1+2.5 = 6, page inset 8, book 277, ticket 313, chart 1382-16-12-277-313 = 764. NOT MEASURED LIVE. Whether this terminal gives up its viewport fit is a product call, not a measurement. THE ROW'S OWN NUMBER IS NOW ON AN ELEMENT THIS BOARD RENDERS. 768 is drawn entirely by MobileTradeShell, and the 544 chart floor report 535eea9b asks for (9135-85292 is 708x584, a 40 tab row over the 708x544 TradingView) was written a second time in the DESKTOP return as `md:min-h-[min(544px,62vh)]` under an lg:min-h-0 sibling. Commit c0fe6f2a6.
